headline: US-Iran Pact Redefines Middle East Energy Geopolitics and Global Supply Chains
summary: A newly reported US-Iran pact signals the resolution of a significant regional conflict, fundamentally reshaping energy maps and easing prior crises. This major geopolitical shift will stabilize energy markets, impact global trade routes, and indirectly reduce supply chain risks for critical tech industries.

headline: Taiwan Tightens AI Chip Export Controls to China, Intensifying Global Tech War
summary: Taiwan's new regulatory restrictions on advanced AI chip exports to China will directly impact global AI infrastructure development and semiconductor fab strategies. This move exacerbates existing geopolitical tensions and further fragments the technology supply chain between major economic blocs.

headline: Pentagon Confirms Commercial AI Chatbot Used to Launch Missiles in Iran War
summary: The confirmed offensive deployment of a commercial AI chatbot, Grok, by the US military to launch thousands of missiles against Iran marks a critical geopolitical turning point for AI in warfare. This development raises profound ethical, legal, and strategic questions about autonomous weapons, the role of private technology in state conflict, and will accelerate the global AI arms race and discussions on international AI governance.
